reference_consequences: All moved bytes retain SHA256; no accepted raw snapshot or old manifest content is rewritten. Existing frozen manifests may embed old paths; retain them as historical and publish an additive locator/current binding mapping each old path/hash to current archive path/hash. A relocation changes locator truth even when content digest is unchanged.

Current portable acceptance/release controls should consume portable archive references and exact hashes at an authorized later boundary; preserve old snapshot references as historical origins. Do not silently edit hash-bound acceptance records. Named possible reference consumers are string-based candidates, not proof of a resolved dependency.

Native preparation manifests referencing the four raw files must be retained immutable with an explicit historical-to-current mapping; a new current native wrapper must bind relocated files. Check all relative links, not just absolute-path findings. If individual native move breaks relationship semantics, archive the minimal closed native preparation packet instead after root decides.

RESULTS manifests and sealed writer context remain active/original-lane sources until writer freeze. Later import may place exact offending context directly at archive destinations with portable binding; never mutate its live lane or copy all earlier history. Portable new live writer briefs should point to approved contexts using repo-relative paths or REPO_ROOT/WORKING_ROOT placeholders.

The root named examples undercounted affected records: two UI witness manifests, two result-review manifests, old sealed review brief and old phase1 BRIEF also require disposition. Both byte-identical copies of the completed result-backcheck brief may map to one canonical blob only after equality is proven and mappings retained; do not assume identity from names.

Runtime gate later validates actual staged placement. No policy exceptions, suffix evasion, classifier modifications, suppression, source changes or Plan-card claim.
